final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no new admissible evidence; the response mainly reframed the same record and expressly conceded the key missing predicates. The narrowed position is more precise than the original broad certification defense, but it still depends on an unresolved compliance condition: completed disclosure before launch or approved risk acceptance. Under the provided policy text and evidence, that condition is not yet shown to be satisfied. General governance guidance and aggregate readiness evidence remain supportive context, not substitutes for the case-specific requirement. Because the caveat identifies a missing predicate rather than a completed control, the record still supports a suspicious finding rather than compliant_with_caveats.
remaining_concerns: No admissible evidence shows the pharmacy prior authorization limitation has been disclosed in a prelaunch model card or equivalent artifact.
No admissible evidence shows an approved risk-acceptance record exists.
The affected segment misses target by 1.2 percentage points and is named in two payer pilot commitments, which keeps the weakness material under the provided policy text.
Legal review on whether disclosure is required remains open, so a policy predicate for compliant certification is unresolved.
